name: operations.prefunds

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Select exactly APPROVED+CLOSED or SUBMITTED+REJECTED+CLOSED_SUBMITTED; repeat for the complete set.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Exact case-sensitive local currency match; repeat for alternatives. Acquisition retains the full status view.

get.description: Read only the selected native prefund application root; no historical applications or drawdown acquisition.

lookup.name: preFundingId
lookup.description: Native List id of one selected application/version row. prefundingBizNo is a separate business grouping reference.

result_identity.description: Native selected application row id, echoed exactly without selecting a newer version.

purpose: Inspect native operational records through bounded inquiry-only requests.

fields.name: id
fields.meaning: Native nonempty row identity, retained without conversion.

fields.name: prefundingBizNo
fields.meaning: Native business grouping reference; not row identity.

fields.name: version
fields.meaning: Native version value; retained without version selection.

identity_description: Native id identifies rows within the exact acquisition scope.
limitations: Full native fields, types, exact decimals, nested values and unknown fields are retained. Ordinary List performs no Get or additional inquiry.
Width 1000 is qualified for complete acquisition, not a measured backend maximum. SDK collection owns loops, deadlines, retries, quality and cache publication.
Duplicates, count gaps and short interior pages remain incomplete. Conflicts keep the last arrival; strict refresh rejects incomplete data and preserves the prior saved capture.
Fixed outer and inner tenant GUAPW3SG; exact outer timezone GMt+8. Mandatory qualified status views are separately acquired and canonicalized to frontend ordering.

Native id identifies the application/version row; prefundingBizNo is a distinct business reference. Get preserves only selected native result.data and already-returned arrays such as approverList/fileUrlList. No latest-version selection, APPROVED_FINAL historyApplications, drawdownDetails, current-version inquiries, balance recalculation or attachment download.
Repeated currency selectors apply locally after full native acquisition and do not change its status scope.
Get and List --live --with-detail perform no cache or Duckdog writes. Success covers the selected native application root, not complete prefunding business history or drawdown coverage.

examples.title: Acquire a complete native List
examples.command: dogopencli liquidity list operations.prefunds --live --require-complete --status APPROVED --status CLOSED

examples.title: Combine a selected List window with native application detail
examples.command: dogopencli liquidity list operations.prefunds --live --with-detail --status APPROVED --status CLOSED --offset 1 --limit 1 --require-complete
